name: ETC Eos
hint: a cue number (2 or 2.5), or cuelist/cue (3/9)

capture.source: an ETC community post and a TroikaTronix forum post: Eos sends /eos/out/event/cue/<list>/<cue>/fire, with no data, when a cue is taken. Not an ETC documentation page

notes: Set Eos's OSC output (UDP TX) to this machine and the Listen port in the Rig tab to the same port to capture the cues you fire on the console.
